text: A tiered aluminium display rack or shelving unit stands against a pale wall, photographed at close range and slightly blurred. Three or four horizontal rows of white rectangular label plates are mounted along the metal rails, each bearing a purple square icon panel beside printed text in Chinese characters and Latin letters/numbers (visible strings include "Dragon skin 30", "Sylgard DC184", "Mold 1", "Mold 3", "Si-Pigment Yellow", "Si-Pigment Brown", "Si-Pigment Green", "Si-Pigment Black", "YMM-10.7", "YMM-7.4", "YMM-15.7"). On the lowest visible shelf, a single small dark teal cylindrical container stands upright, uncapped, near the centre. Flat clear trays or lids rest on the top shelf at left. A dark table edge and a magenta-and-white sign appear top right.
